description:
Upstream's `app.thinking.toggle` (Ctrl+T) toggles whether thinking blocks are shown or hidden in the transcript. Our Interactive has a `set_hidden_thinking_label` UI override but no keyboard shortcut to toggle it.

Implement: Ctrl+T toggles a `thinking_visible` flag in state, which the AssistantMessage renderer checks to show/hide thinking content blocks.

Ref: `interactive-mode.ts` L2356.
title: Interactive: toggle thinking block visibility (Ctrl+T)
